messages:
Maria L.: quick heads-up, ran the audit-coverage scan across gateway / auth / console / billing / runtime. found several gaps and a few schema mismatches. can we triage backlog and pick owners?

Devon K.: looked at gateway: apigw events missing route_id and client_cert fields in 20% of change events. also no event_schema_version header.

Alex R.: +1 on schema version. we should add an optional "event_schema_version" and make new fields optional to avoid breaking customers.

Maria L.: proposing v2: optional fields + migration notes. also billing emits invoice.change events that lack kms_key_id and key_operation (Encrypt/Decrypt) — we need KMS audit linkage for compliance.

Jamal S.: billing gap is concerning for enterprise audits. we should log kms_key_id (hashed) and key_operation enum. retention will be different for billing events.

Sam (eng-platform): retention question: recommend 90d hot + 1y archive for enterprise by default, with opt-outs. also we must ensure we never log raw tokens or PII — hash or mask them.

Devon K.: auth gaps: admin actions missing impersonator field and actor.ip in ~12 endpoints. sec-bot flagged these earlier.

sec-bot: Automated alert: services missing "actor.ip" detected: gateway, auth, runtime. See ticket INF-3821.

Lee T.: runtime (inference) needs model provenance fields: model_id, model_sha, quant_profile, node_id. also we should avoid logging raw model keys — log references only.

Maria L.: example event for v2 (canary):
```
{
  "event_schema_version": "2",
  "service": "gateway",
  "action": "route.update",
  "route_id": "r-123",
  "user": "u@company.com",
  "impersonator": null
}
```

Alex R.: plan: 1) add optional fields (v2) behind feature flag; 2) canary on dedicated customers; 3) provide migration notes and validation tool so customers can run audit-export checks before enabling.

Devon K.: I'll draft the PR to add fields + feature flag. propose rollout timeline: canary week 1, opt-in enterprise week 2-3, global default week 6.

Jamal S.: will update billing consumers and add KMS key usage mapping. also file a follow-up for retention and export compliance.

Sam (eng-platform): will scope console changes (UI audit events) and add masking for user identifiers.

Lee T.: question — do we log full token ids for runtime auth? we should hash prefix only.

Maria L.: agreed — mask token ids, store KMS key usage separately via audit entries referencing key_hash. no raw tokens.

Alex R.: also add regression evals for log consumers: billing jobs, infra-alerting, and customer export pipelines. I'll coordinate test cases.

Maria L.: assigning owners: gateway=Devon K., auth=Alex R., console=Sam (eng-platform), billing=Jamal S., runtime=Lee T. I'll create the parent ticket and break into service sub-tickets.

Devon K.: opening INF-4007 with checklist and PR link. will include sample consumer tests and validation tool.

Maria L.: can we sync tomorrow 9am PT for a quick triage + rollout planning?

Alex R.: yes. I'll add the meeting and include the PR checklist.

All: :thumbsup:
